$description: Raft Design System tokens in the Design Tokens Community Group format (2025.10). This file is the source of packages/ui/src/foundation.css: edit it, then run `vp run @botiverse/raft-ui#build:tokens`. Extensions under "build.botiverse.raft": `modes.dark` is the dark-mode value; `scope` is `root` for mode-independent palette values and `every-mode` for aliases declared again in each mode scope; `css: true` marks a value kept as a CSS expression (color-mix, multi-layer shadows) that the format has no type for.

on-hud-muted.$description: Secondary text on the HUD: the shortcut in a tooltip, the detail line of a toast.

hover.$description: Pressing a sticker lays sticker-pressed (12% ink) over its colour.

$root.$description: Every solid is a sticker: ink type on the colour in both modes.
danger = the destructive sticker (red fill, ink type); danger-strong is the error ink for invalid fields and destructive menu items.

float.$description: Controls never cast a shadow; only overlays float.

deprecated.$description: Former names, kept as aliases until raft-ui 1.0. Keys are the CSS custom property names.

theme-shadow-xs.$deprecated: Controls cast no shadow; drop the class.

theme-shadow-sm.$deprecated: Controls cast no shadow; drop the class.

theme-shadow-md.$deprecated: Controls cast no shadow; drop the class.
